name: Sample Clean Token
summary: This token looks clean. Mint and freeze authorities have been revoked, the supply is spread across a wide base of holders, and no suspicious promises were found on the website. Every investment still carries risk.

checks.label: Can new tokens be minted?
checks.detail: No. Mint authority has been permanently revoked.

checks.label: Can your sale be frozen?
checks.detail: No. Freeze authority has been revoked.

checks.label: Who holds the supply?
checks.detail: The top 10 wallets hold 18% of the supply.

checks.label: Is there enough liquidity?
checks.detail: The pool holds about $2.4 million in liquidity.

checks.label: Is the website trustworthy?
checks.detail: No suspicious promises found; documentation and team information are available.
